name: Mobile Sensor Relays
summary: Leagues of Votann Transports grant Sustained Hits 1 to a friendly Infantry unit's ranged weapons while that unit is wholly within 6" of the Transport.

name: Eye of the Hunt
summary: Hernkyn units' ranged attacks against targets within 12" gain +1 to hit rolls.

name: Methodical Annihilation
summary: A Leagues of Votann model attacking the closest eligible target, or one within its unit's Engagement Range, re-rolls a Wound roll of 1; if its unit is Kahl, Einhyr Hearthguard or Uthar the Destined, that attack gets +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Optimal Application
summary: End of your Command phase, gain 1YP per objective held outside your deployment zone within range of an Iron-Master or Memnyr Strategist, max 2YP. Spend 1YP when a Brokhyr, Ironkin Steeljacks or Arkanyst Evaluator shoots to re-roll Hit 1s.

name: Avatars of the Ancestors
summary: Kahl, Einhyr Champion, Einhyr Hearthguard and Uthar the Destined units re-roll wound rolls of 1 on ranged attacks against targets within 9". Cannot be combined with another Hearthguard detachment.

name: Ruthless Reinvestment
summary: Replaces the army rule's automatic switching: units start the battle with Hostile Acquisition, and each Command phase you can spend 3YP to swap all your units between Hostile Acquisition and Fortify Takeover.

name: Martial Leverage
summary: Gain 1 Yield Point each time an enemy unit is destroyed.

name: Assailed From Every Angle
summary: When selected to shoot, a unit can name one enemy unit (not Monster/Vehicle) as its only target that phase; if any attack hits, that enemy is assailed until your next Shooting phase, or also pinned (-2" Move, -2 Charge) if already assailed.
